mailboxGroups.title: Mailbox groups
mailboxGroups.addressHelp: Optional distribution address in the group’s domain. Leave empty for a group used only for permissions.
mailboxGroups.membersHelp: Choose the mailboxes that belong to this group. Identity-managed and out-of-scope members are preserved.
mailboxGroups.lockedMembers: These memberships are managed elsewhere and cannot be removed here.
mailboxGroups.sendAsHelp: Existing mailbox or alias addresses, or a domain prefixed with the at sign. Separate entries with new lines. The group’s own address uses “Allow sending as the group address”.
mailboxGroups.sharingHelp: Access changes may remain pending until mailcow applies them. Subscriptions are maintained by mailcow’s scheduled tasks.
mailboxGroups.templateHelp: The active group with the highest priority supplies a member’s template. Equal priorities use the lowest group ID. Leaving all groups keeps the mailbox settings.
mailboxGroups.identityReferenceHelp: Optional stable reference used by identity-provider group synchronisation.
mailboxGroups.reapplyConfirm: Apply each member’s effective group template again? This can replace their manually changed settings.
mailboxGroups.removeConfirm: Delete “{name}”, its distribution address and group permissions? Member mailboxes will remain.
